## Checklist

- [ ] `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` passes (from `android/`)
- [ ] New or changed text is in `values/strings.xml` and the four translations
- [ ] No message text, names, step numbers or diagnostics URLs in logs
- [ ] Protocol claims are backed by an observation and recorded in `docs/PROTOCOL.md`
- [ ] No APKs, keystores, secrets or Casio code/firmware in the change
